messages.content: We have updated our billing and supply details however we cannot amend ECOES as according to Royal Mail and Council Tax websites, Centenary Buildings are apt 34-93

In a previous response to our ET, dated 2025-04-24, you said 'ECOES holds as 47 but this is supply to Flat 14'. Our customer lives at flat 47, and has confirmed the serial number on their meter as the one we are supplying, at MPAN 1300060940784. They have received a paper bill from SSE for MPAN 1300060940455, which is not theirs. Please send the flows to update the address, and issue your bill to the correct flat.

We have received your D0301 with cancellation code G. We are unable to cancel this ET as we have already regained supply as of 27/11/2025. If this is to return to FUSE, you will need to regain as a new agreement.
